limits: Thread stress is not a race detector.
Reserved location and quest gates remain unsupported.
Robot/creature gates use real keywords on a disposable humanoid; other skeletons and combat encounters are not certified.
Pack checks use one unchanged authored definition at a time. Actual jail/sentence handling requires a security-and-bounty fixture; no statistical distribution claim.
The captive is a fresh persistent NPC clone; nonpersistent world NPCs and cross-cell transfers need additional fixtures.
Real timers and restored holds are exercised in a quiet cell.
The VM consumer binds to the player; arbitrary third-party consumers and quest-alias initialization remain outside this fixture.

area: Persistence ABI, migration, corruption and real save/load
limits: Real save/load occurs within one fresh process. Cold restart, failed/cancelled loads and nonpersistent NPC streaming need separate scenarios.

area: Damage interception, resist, imminent events and NPC routing
limits: The installed player hook is exercised; opt-in hostile NPC lethal damage still needs a combat fixture.
